title: Motor Vehicle Information – Registrar’s decisions and notifications
text:
Neither the CM nor the PHN is considered personal driving and motor vehicle information, as defined in the
Traffic Safety Act
,
and therefore, AMVIR does not govern their release. This RDN is published to announce new release channels and new Motor Vehicle Information Products for the release of personal driving and motor vehicle information that will enable the display of the CM and PHN on DL and ID cards.
Accordingly, the Registrar of Motor Vehicle Services decides to announce:
three new release channels for Type I Information required to facilitate the inclusion of Alberta’s PHN and CM on Alberta DL/ID cards:
PHN Validation
Alberta Birth Validation
Card Management
four new Motor Vehicle Information Products (MVIPs) to be released by the Registrar to PPHS, under AMVIR:
PHN Validation Batch Release File
Card Cancellation Notification
Card Recall Request
Card Recall Confirmation
Registrar’s Decisions: Notification 01/2026 (RDN 01/2026)
– New as of June 29, 2026
Section 2(1)(j.2) of the Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR) was amended on November 26, 2025, by replacing the reference to the Insurance Crime Prevention Bureau with Équité Association.
